title: Vignette 2026-10-30: I cannot understand these repos in srs-web; the three columns may be the wrong start

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30: "ok. now, lets return to our broader goal. How do we build repos that are meaningfl for humans. 
Have we captured all our research and issues? 
I also want to test these new repos when they are opened in srs-web. And suggest what change we can make on srs-web that can attempt to make some kind of sense of these repos. 

To be honest, I cannot understand them at all. It may just be that the three column layout is not the right starting point."
